conclusions: PipelineConfig is flat, while SDK file loading also accepts a document that wraps it under pipeline.
The portable official example uses the all-zero project UUID and infers its source from one mode Source component.
The Python SDK unwraps an outer pipeline object for file execution, so wrapped pipe documents remain executable.
RocketRide Cloud 3.3.0 validation currently requires that outer object because rrext_validate passes its value to an engine validator that expects a pipeline member.
The HTTP request and MCP client nodes are agent tools and are excluded.
The tool_n8n data lane uses a configured host and path and supports bearer authentication.
No agent or control connection is needed for the fixed callback pipeline.
SDK use returns a task token; send submits data; terminate releases the task.
reviewed_scope: RocketRide pipeline shape, Python SDK lifecycle, and deterministic callback node
